findings.title: `enableSqlExpressions` always returns false, so SQL expression queries are rejected even when the `sqlExpressions` flag is enabled
findings.description: `enableSqlExpressions` computes `enabled := !h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(featuremgmt.FlagSqlExpressions)`, then returns `false` in both branches of `if enabled { return false }`. Its result never depends on the flag. In `ReadQuery`, every `QueryTypeSQL` node hits the gate at `pkg/expr/reader.go:128-132` and returns `fmt.Errorf("sqlExpressions is not implemented")` before the query is read. The production callers pass real toggles (`pkg/expr/nodes.go:132`, under `FlagExpressionParser`, and `pkg/registry/apis/query/register.go:56`). Enabling `sqlExpressions`, which `pkg/services/featuremgmt/toggles_gen.go:582-584` documents as "Enables using SQL and DuckDB functions as Expressions", therefore has no effect.

findings.title: `sql.DB` stub methods return "not implemented", so every SQL expression fails at construction and at execution
findings.description:
The base commit ran SQL expressions on `github.com/scottlepp/go-duck`'s in-memory DuckDB, through `duck.NewInMemoryDB()` in `pkg/expr/sql/parser.go` and `pkg/expr/sql_command.go`. This diff swaps that for `NewInMemoryDB()`, whose `RunCommands` (`db.go:16-18`) and `QueryFramesInto` (`db.go:20-22`) both return `errors.New("not implemented")`. That breaks two paths for every SQL query:

- **Construction:** `NewSQLCommand` (`pkg/expr/sql_command.go:30`) calls `sql.TablesList`. That calls `NewInMemoryDB().RunCommands` (`pkg/expr/sql/parser.go:23-26`), which errors. `TablesList` returns "error serializing sql", and `NewSQLCommand` maps it to `errutil.BadRequest("sql-invalid-sql")` (`sql_command.go:31-36`).
- **Execution:** `SQLCommand.Execute` (`pkg/expr/sql_command.go:96-105`) calls `db.QueryFramesInto`, which returns "not implemented". That error lands in `rsp.Error`.

Even with the gate at `reader.go:194-200` fixed, no SQL expression can be created or executed. The existing SQL tests (`pkg/expr/sql/parser_test.go`, `pkg/expr/sql_command_test.go`) are all `t.Skip()`'d, so the suite does not exercise this path. If the stub is scaffolding for a future backend, it should not sit on a default path as a working expression type. Either restore a working backend or keep the feature explicitly disabled.

structured_findings.summary: `enableSqlExpressions` always returns false, so SQL expression queries are rejected even when the `sqlExpressions` flag is enabled
`sql.DB` stub methods return "not implemented", so every SQL expression fails at construction and at execution
